# Pandoc 3.11

The image contains the unmodified official Pandoc 3.11 Linux binary archive.
COPYRIGHT and COPYING.md are copied verbatim from upstream tag 3.11 and include
the upstream component notices and GPL text. They are installed alongside this
file in /usr/local/share/doc/pandoc.

Source reference: https://github.com/jgm/pandoc/tree/3.11
Source distribution: https://hackage.haskell.org/package/pandoc-3.11/pandoc-3.11.tar.gz
Binary releases: https://github.com/jgm/pandoc/releases/tag/3.11

These references are provenance, not a written source offer or a determination
that all distribution obligations are satisfied. The deployment owner must
confirm corresponding-source delivery for the actual distribution arrangement,
including dependencies used to build the binary. Update these files when the
converter version changes.
